title: BabyBabelLM: A Multilingual Benchmark of Developmentally Plausible Training Data
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating and benchmarking a multilingual dataset for developmentally plausible language modeling. Although it includes TruthfulQA in its evaluation suite and mentions sourcing religious education materials for its Greek training corpus, these elements are incidental to the primary goal of modeling language acquisition and data efficiency; the paper does not specifically analyze or focus on religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of its research.
